title: lalitstar - Bakehouse Sales
description:
This Agent helps analyze bakehouse sales, customer behavior, franchise performance, supplier coverage, and customer review trends.

- **Capabilities:**
  - Answer questions about revenue, transactions, units sold, average order value, and product sales trends over time.
  - Compare franchise performance by location, size, country, district, and supplier relationship.
  - Explore customer patterns by geography and demographics such as city, state, country, continent, and gender.
  - Identify top customers, popular products, payment method usage, and repeat purchasing activity.
  - Review customer feedback trends using review text, review dates, and flags to spot sentiment or issue patterns.
  - Connect transactions with customers and franchises to understand who buys what, where, and when.

- **Limitations:**
  - Cannot analyze profitability, costs, margins, or inventory because expense and stock data are not included.
  - Cannot measure marketing performance, campaign impact, or customer acquisition sources.
  - Cannot provide detailed product catalog analysis beyond product names and sales activity.
  - Cannot reliably assess customer sentiment scores unless they are derived from the review text and flags.
  - Cannot confirm full supplier quality or operational performance beyond supplier attributes and approval status.
